reasoning_details.text:
Since this is the 2022 annual report with only 12-month data and no Q4 figures, I'm leaving quarterly cells empty and filling in only annual ones. I'm structuring the output as a JSON array of 24 objects with quote, value, base, change, and score fields for numeric items, and quote/score for qualitative ones. Starting with CEO tone, I'm scoring it negative given phrases like "сложнейшим," "антикризисный план," and "строжайшей экономии," then moving to capital adequacy where Н20.0 rose from 13.6% to 14.4%, a +0.8pp improvement year-over-year.

I'm working through each metric: portfolio quality shows stage 3 share improving to 3.9% (-100bp, positive); cost of risk worsened sharply to 1.9% from 0.6% (+1.3pp, negative); tech development gets a positive score with 80% migration; book value per share rose 3.1% to 257.4; market share gained across consumer, cards, and SME segments while mortgage was flat; cost-to-income ratio deteriorated significantly to 41.6% from 34.0%; customer funds grew 9.1% to 29,876; fee income jumped over 15% (strong positive); opex fell 1.5% but I can't score it fully since operating income before provisions isn't given, so I'm leaving that score neutral. Digital metrics show MAU growth of 2.5 million users (+3.3%, positive); no forward guidance was given but dividends got a positive nod since the bank signaled it may revisit the topic; retail loans grew 12.2%; NIM was roughly flat at 5.31 vs 5.38; and I'm now looking at the provisions figures, which jumped sharply to 555.4 from 141.

Now I'm assessing external conditions — sanctions, deposit outflows, and rate hikes weighed on the first half, but there was some stabilization and rate declines later in the year, so I'm settling on a moderate negative score rather than the most severe one. EPS collapsed 78.3% (strongly negative), corporate loans grew 13.2% FX-adjusted (positive), NII rose 6.6% (positive), net profit was down (negative), and ROE cratered nearly 19pp to 5.2% from 24.2% (strongly negative). Active clients grew 2.8%, just under the 3% threshold, so I'm scoring that as neutral since the percentage change wasn't explicitly stated in the source. Now I just need to assemble all these scores into a compact JSON structure.
